topics.topic_name: Password/PIN entropy and guessability (bits of security)
topics.justification: Top terms like "bit", "entropy", "guess", "attacker", and "pin" point to estimating entropy in bits and translating that into attacker guessing effort and time (especially for numeric PIN-style secrets).

topics.topic_name: Brute-force key search and basic cryptanalysis framing
topics.justification: Words such as "key", "encryption", "cipher", "plaintext", "decrypt", and "search/break" indicate discussions about trying keys against encrypted text/messages/files, i.e., brute-force key search and related cryptanalysis context.

topics.topic_name: Password search space from length and character set (brute-force cracking)
topics.justification: The dominant terms "password", "character", "length", "set", "space", "brute_force", and "crack/hash" reflect calculating password keyspace based on length/charset and estimating brute-force cracking difficulty and time.

topics.topic_name: Passphrases vs complex passwords (dictionary words, usability, composition rules)
topics.justification: "passphrase", "word", "dictionary", "random", "remember", "rule", and "symbol" suggest guidance and debate on using word-based passphrases versus character-composition rules, balancing strength with memorability/usability.

topics.topic_name: Password storage and account security (hashing, salting, managers, attacks)
topics.justification: Terms like "store", "hash", "salt", "system/site/account", "attack/crack", and "password_manager" indicate posts about secure password handling in systems—how to store/verify passwords and mitigate attacks.
